title: fix(reporter): `agent` to respect `--silent`
body:
### Description

Following the review request, removes the runtime precedence changes. Current source and freshly built declarations already expose `silent` through `DefaultReporterOptions` / `BaseOptions` for both `minimal` and `agent`, so no additional type declaration change was necessary.

Adds type coverage for the exact `boolean | 'passed-only' | undefined` option type and config tuples using all three values. Global `silent` precedence and reporter defaults remain unchanged.

Refs #11266.

### Validation

- Full workspace build passed.
- Focused reporter configuration type tests: 5 passed, no type errors.
- Workspace `pnpm typecheck` passed.
- `CI=true pnpm lint:fix` and `git diff --check` passed.

The PR remains a draft.
